name: Split an amount across weights without losing a cent
prompt: Finance reports that the invoice splitter does not add up. src/allocate.js exports allocate(totalCents, weights), which divides a total across weighted lines and returns whole cents per line. The lines it returns do not sum back to totalCents, so the ledger is off by a cent or two on most invoices. The existing test suite is green today, so it does not describe this. Fix src/allocate.js so the returned allocations always sum to exactly totalCents, no line is negative, and the split stays fair: no two lines may differ by more than one cent. Do not change any test file. Verify against the cases the report describes before you call it done.
